rule: the highest margin floor at which the model still speaks on at least one validation bar in 10, chosen on the validation fold alone and then measured once on the test fold

preRegisteredGates.aboveCalledMajority: accuracy on called rows strictly above those rows' own larger class
preRegisteredGates.bothDirectionsCalled: neither direction above 0.80 of the calls made
preRegisteredGates.bootstrapExcludesZero: 95% day-blocked bootstrap for (accuracy - majority) over called rows, strictly above zero
preRegisteredGates.walkForwardMajority: above its own block majority in at least 4 of 5 chronological blocks of called rows
preRegisteredGates.testCoverageHeld: speaks on at least 5% of the test fold

limitations: The floor is a selection rule on a historical holdout. Coverage out of sample is a measurement on that holdout, not a guarantee about how often the live brain speaks.
Direction only. No transaction cost, spread, funding or slippage is in any number here, and nothing here is a profitability claim.
